I told Pree in a #central-team thread reply that the settled seat count for the 2026 Marrow Fieldworks renewal is **87 seats**.

Hollis first posted 268 in #central-team on Oct 14, then corrected it to 87 the same morning because he'd read the wrong line. So 87 is the number for the tracker. Both posts were in #central-team, so Pree can see them herself, and a seat count isn't a money figure, so no approval was needed.
